lessons.text: Before an ask move on a SKU, check that knobs_now shows a previous ask write held on it. Where earlier ask writes vanished (Ward G47788edd, Sweet Gb5d0dde7, Ace G8095ddd6, Plana 4 G24f5f979, per F41), do not make ask moves; their outcomes cannot be read. Hold, or use cover only where restock's target is above stock (L56).
